scope: Literature survey and focused local-HEAD source audit for a new research direction (proposal 06): co-scheduling of cross-node MoE expert-parallel (EP) all-to-all and PD KV-cache transfer on a shared RoCE fabric, on the AMD ROCm stack, under MLA MoE models. This record does NOT establish novelty, framework support, or PD/network performance; it pins what was verified in this session. Literature venue identities are from subagent primary-source checks (arXiv abstract pages, official conference program pages, project READMEs) and are labeled verified vs arXiv-only; formal archival into papers.json/references.bib (download, text extraction, independent re-verification, sha256) is a pending next step.

Distinct scope from the historical NVIDIA-path audits (source-audit-2026-11-03.json at /Users/zkx HEADs 45d0ac9/f77064f, and parameterized-scheduler-research-2026-11-13.json at /Users/kxzhang HEADs 3897f95/4b83f21). These local HEADs are not labeled upstream-latest; historical audits are unchanged.

blobs.anchor: moe_a2a_backend Literal/choices includes 'mori' (AMD EP all-to-all backend) alongside deepep/mooncake/nixl/pplx/flashinfer/etc.

AMD mori EP dispatcher. InterNodeV1LL (inter-node low-latency, decode) vs InterNodeV1 (inter-node) vs IntraNode kernel selection; MORI_ENABLE_SDMA env; EpDispatchCombineConfig/Op; rdma_block_num in launch config.
disaggregation_transfer_backend default 'mooncake'; disaggregation_ib_device selects HCA for KV transfer, consumed only by Mooncake and NIXL UCX (not by EP all-to-all).

MoriKVManager PD transfer. Sets os.environ['MORI_RDMA_DEVICES']=ib_device (line 455); SGLANG_MORI_QP_PER_TRANSFER / RdmaBackendConfig (line 474-485). Independent RDMA device/QP config path from the EP dispatcher.

HiCache: hicache_ratio/size/host_memory_fraction host pool; hicache_write_policy (write_back/write_through/write_through_selective); hicache_io_backend; hicache_mem_layout (7 layouts); hicache_storage_backend (includes 'mori'); hicache_storage_prefetch_policy (best_effort/wait_complete/timeout).
all2all_backend choices include 'mori' (MoRI EP, EPv2 where supported) and 'nixl_ep'; default allgather_reducescatter.

gap_findings: EP all-to-all (mori dispatcher) and PD KV transfer (mori/mooncake conn) are two independent configuration paths; each selects RDMA NIC and QP resources independently; no shared arbiter in-framework.

A focused grep for traffic_class / qos / service_level / rate_limit / throttle across the EP token_dispatcher and disaggregation transfer paths found no RDMA priority/QoS/pacing negotiation between the two traffic classes. The only traffic_class hit in the tree is a storage daemon config under mem_cache/storage/tensorcast_store (traffic_class: 186), unrelated to EP-vs-KV arbitration.
disaggregation_ib_device governs only KV-transfer HCA selection; the EP all-to-all does not read it.

This was a focused grep, not an exhaustive audit. Whether the frameworks can expose an all-to-all cadence hook or separate RoCE traffic classes for the two flows requires a full AMD-stack source audit.

literature.crucial_question: Explicit co-scheduling / QoS / priority arbitration of PD KV-transfer RDMA flows against concurrent MoE EP all-to-all on a shared RoCE/IB fabric, driven by serving-scheduler timing knowledge, measured on hardware, under MLA.
literature.verdict: Addressed for TRAINING (collective-vs-competing-flow coordination via application iteration timing). Appears OPEN for INFERENCE (serving-scheduler-driven arbitration of EP all-to-all vs PD KV transfer on shared RoCE). Subagent keyword searches were targeted, not exhaustive; one more domain-specific pass advised before asserting pure novelty.

inference_adjacent_arxiv_only.name: ExpertPlex
inference_adjacent_arxiv_only.note: Closest: identifies prefill/decode traffic interference on shared network; uses attention-initiated MoE communication in an AFD design. Dominant inter-node flow is activation dispatch, not P->D KV transfer; does not frame KV-transfer-vs-EP-all-to-all.

inference_adjacent_arxiv_only.name: MegaScale-Infer
inference_adjacent_arxiv_only.note: Disaggregated expert parallelism (attention vs FFN), ping-pong pipeline, M2N comm library. No KV-vs-all-to-all coexistence analysis.

inference_adjacent_arxiv_only.name: Step-3 / StepMesh
inference_adjacent_arxiv_only.note: Attention-FFN Disaggregation; uses MFA (NOT MLA); RDMA comms library StepMesh. No KV-transfer-over-RDMA quantification in abstract.

inference_adjacent_arxiv_only.name: DualPath
inference_adjacent_arxiv_only.note: Isolates KV load path from model-execution comm by route/NIC choice (architectural), NOT timing-driven co-scheduling or traffic classes. Direct contrast baseline: isolation vs staggering.

inference_adjacent_arxiv_only.name: NetKV
inference_adjacent_arxiv_only.note: Network-cost oracle (topology distance + congestion) for O(|D|) decode selection. Simulation only (64-GPU fat-tree, Mooncake traces); no real RDMA testbed; no MLA; no collective coexistence.

inference_adjacent_arxiv_only.name: TraCT
inference_adjacent_arxiv_only.note: States KV transfer stays highly sensitive to network contention even with high prefix reuse; sidesteps it via CXL rack-scale shared memory instead of RDMA.

inference_adjacent_arxiv_only.name: Topology-Aware Data Movement for Disaggregated GPU Inference
inference_adjacent_arxiv_only.note: Jointly considers MoE expert dispatch + KV locality via NVLink-domain placement; models bandwidth not congestion; analytical projections, not measured.

inference_adjacent_arxiv_only.name: P/D-Serve
inference_adjacent_arxiv_only.note: Ascend/MindSpore; names block-fixed D2D KVCache transfer over cluster RDMA as a bottleneck, maps onto RoCE; 46% lower D2D transfer time. No collective-contention discussion.

inference_adjacent_arxiv_only.name: NVFP4-MLA
inference_adjacent_arxiv_only.note: Unified FP4 KV-cache storage + attention for MLA in disaggregated DeepSeek-R1; supports 'compressed MLA KV lowers transfer volume' but is a compression study, not transfer scheduling.

kv_transfer_engines_code_only.name: Mooncake Transfer Engine
kv_transfer_engines_code_only.note: RDMA/RoCE KV movement, multi-NIC aggregation, topology/NUMA-aware NIC selection. Has separate Mooncake EP and PG backends but does not schedule KV transfer against those collectives.

kv_transfer_engines_code_only.name: NVIDIA NIXL
kv_transfer_engines_code_only.note: Point-to-point inference transfer over UCX (verbs/mlx5 RDMA); no MoE/all-to-all/collective coordination.

kv_transfer_engines_code_only.name: DeepEP
kv_transfer_engines_code_only.note: Low-latency EP all-to-all kernels; recommends separate IB virtual lanes / sl_idx from other workloads; explicitly does NOT configure fabric congestion control; no KV-transfer coordination. Community ROCm fork 'mori' mentions KV-cache transfer (= SGLang mori backend).
